page_title: BRE 0-0 BHA | Brentford v Brighton 03/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the right post.

90+1' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
90+1' Pascal Gross (Brighton) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+1' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' That's unlucky! Jakub Moder (Brighton) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
87' Joao Pedro (Brighton) attempts to put the rebound into the middle of the goal, but his effort from just outside the penalty area is well anticipated and stopped by Mark Flekken.
87' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
86' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Joel Veltman is replaced by Jakub Moder (Brighton).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathias Jensen trots off the pitch and is replaced by Frank Onyeka (Brentford).
82' Ivan Toney (Brentford) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
81' Julio Enciso (Brighton) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Mark Flekken.
80' Igor (Brighton) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
79' The current number of corner kicks is 1:4.
76' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) has tested the patience of referee Andy Madley and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' The ball rebounds out to Carlos Baleba (Brighton) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
75' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is caught offside!
74' Substitution. Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) replaces Facundo Buonanotte.
74' The game has come to an end for Simon Adingra. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Danny Welbeck (Brighton).
73' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) replacing Yoane Wissa.
73' A substitution has been made. Keane Lewis-Potter is replaced by Sergio Reguilon (Brentford).
72' Julio Enciso (Brighton) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies well wide of the right post.
70' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
69' Ivan Toney (Brentford) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
67' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) jumps into a tackle and Andy Madley signals a foul.
64' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Adam Lallana will be replaced by Julio Enciso (Brighton).
64' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yegor Yarmolyuk.
64' Simon Adingra (Brighton) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box, but his effort on goal goes well wide of the right post. A really poor shot.
61' A player from Brentford commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
60' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Bart Verbruggen, who smothers the ball.
58' Adam Lallana (Brighton) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
57' The total number of attempts is 3:11.
55' Brighton keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
53' Andy Madley shows a yellow card to Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) for his blatant foul.
51' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but Bart Verbruggen comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' Joao Pedro (Brighton) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
48' Joel Veltman (Brighton) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just over the bar from inside the box.
47' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Andy Madley blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Referee Andy Madley signals NO PENALTY for Brighton after a VAR review!
45+4' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Brighton! Let's see what he decides.
45+4' PENALTY APPEAL by Brighton, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
45+3' The resulting corner from Pascal Gross (Brighton) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
45+3' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Mark Flekken makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Adam Lallana (Brighton) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
42' The resulting corner from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is cleared.
40' Pascal Gross (Brighton) will take the corner.
39' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
37' Pascal Gross (Brighton) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

35' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mark Flekken pulls off an easy save.

34' Excellent touch by Joao Pedro (Brighton)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
33' Ivan Toney (Brentford) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. Bart Verbruggen is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
32' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 2:5.
29' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts the ball.
28' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) picks up an injury.
25' Pascal Gross (Brighton) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
24' Joao Pedro (Brighton) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
20' A player from Brighton commits a rough challenge. Andy Madley blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
16' Some patient build-up play from Brentford as they look to unlock the defence.
13' The ratio of the ball possession is 23:77.
12' Close! Yoane Wissa (Brentford) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
10' Pascal Gross (Brighton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
9' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Simon Adingra (Brighton), but the defence gets it clear.
7' Joao Pedro (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
5' Zanka (Brentford) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
4' Joao Pedro (Brighton) trips an opposition player and Andy Madley signals a foul.
3' Brighton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
